title: From Conversation to Evaluation: Benchmarking LLMs on Development Knowledge via SimpleDevQA
abstract: arXiv:2512.08867v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The Development Knowledge Question Answering (Dev Knowledge QA) task aims to provide accurate natural language answers to knowledge-seeking questions during software development. To investigate the importance of Dev Knowledge QA in AI-assisted software development and the extent to which it has been explored, we conduct a preliminary analysis of real user-LLM dialogues from WildChat. Our findings indicate that Dev Knowledge QA plays a significant role in real-world software development scenarios, and these raw dialogues cannot be directly used to construct a Dev Knowledge QA benchmark. Existing Dev Knowledge QA benchmarks are limited in development knowledge scope and often not built from real user queries. To bridge this gap, we design a three-phase pipeline that transforms real-world dialogue into simple development knowledge-seeking QA pairs. Through this pipeline, we introduce SimpleDevQA, a multilingual Dev Knowledge QA benchmar

translated_title: 从对话到评测：基于 SimpleDevQA 对大语言模型的开发知识进行基准测试
translated_abstract: 开发知识问答（Dev Knowledge QA）任务旨在为软件开发过程中寻求知识的提问提供准确的自然语言回答。为了探究开发知识问答在 AI 辅助软件开发中的重要性及其被探索研究的程度，我们对来自 WildChat 的真实用户与大语言模型对话进行了初步分析。我们的研究结果表明，开发知识问答在真实软件开发场景中扮演着重要角色，而这些原始对话无法被直接用于构建开发知识问答基准。现有的开发知识问答基准在开发知识范围上较为有限，且往往并非基于真实用户提问构建。为弥补这一空白，我们设计了一个三阶段流水线，将真实世界的对话转化为简单的开发知识问答对。通过该流水线，我们构建了 SimpleDevQA——一个多语言的开发知识问答基准。
tldr: 本文通过分析真实用户与大语言模型的对话并设计三阶段转换流水线，构建了源自真实对话的多语言开发知识问答基准 SimpleDevQA，弥补了现有基准知识范围有限且缺乏真实用户提问的不足。
en_tdlr: By analyzing real user-LLM dialogues and designing a three-phase conversion pipeline, this paper introduces SimpleDevQA, a multilingual Dev Knowledge QA benchmark derived from real-world conversations, addressing the limited knowledge scope and lack of real user queries in existing benchmarks.
